# BetterCtrlV

BetterCtrlV is a Windows clipboard app from ForumCore.

Canonical product page: https://forumcore.ai/betterctrlv/
Publisher: ForumCore, https://forumcore.ai/

Tap Ctrl+V to paste as usual. Hold Ctrl+V to pick an older copy — the current clipboard and the last nine. History stays on your PC, encrypted for your Windows account. Copies from password managers are not saved.

Buy it in the Microsoft Store.

Privacy: https://forumcore.ai/betterctrlv/privacy.html
Terms: https://forumcore.ai/betterctrlv/terms.html
Sitemap: https://forumcore.ai/sitemap.xml
